resources.string: Focused orbit points show the clock and T± side by side, without permanent callouts on other selected points.
Photo and panorama previews have a title bar with Back and Export, and controls aligned at the top.
Images include an object-colour legend; photos have larger wrapping details in a separate black band.
Label and position controls show their enabled state clearly; panorama direction remains a separate choice.
Main islands let paths and objects show through while the reticle stays centred in the free sky area.
The first Observatory section is now Name and type. Saved settings and location privacy are preserved.
